name: Auer Camp
description_short: A farm-based day camp on a 120-acre farm in Bloomfield, CT. It follows a S.T.E.A.M. curriculum built around farm animals, gardening, nature exploration and arts, with groups from a half-day preschool program (ages 3-5) up to a leadership program for grades 9-10. School-vacation camps run for ages 5-12.
refund_policy_summary: Cancellation fees depend on how much notice you give: $50 for more than 30 days, $200 for 14-30 days, $300 for less than 2 weeks.
special_needs_notes: Sprouts (ages 3-5) must be fully potty-trained. Barn activities are adjusted for each child's age and comfort.
swim_waterfront_notes: There is no swimming program listed. Older campers may explore, fish and play in a stream on the farm.
